beginner.name: Digital Foundations & Office Productivity
beginner.outcome: Produce professional documents, spreadsheets and presentations, manage email and calendars, organise files, and work confidently with Microsoft 365.

beginner.name: Microsoft Excel Essentials
beginner.outcome: Build accurate formulas, organise and summarise records, and produce charts and reports.

beginner.name: Introduction to Data Analysis
beginner.outcome: Clean raw data, summarise datasets using tables and charts, and present clear conclusions from data.

beginner.name: Web Development Foundations (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
beginner.outcome: Build responsive multi-page websites, create layouts for mobile and desktop, and publish live websites.

beginner.name: Product Design Foundations (UI/UX)
beginner.outcome: Conduct basic user research, create wireframes and clickable Figma prototypes, and produce a portfolio piece.

beginner.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
beginner.outcome: Understand networks and vulnerabilities, recognise common attacks, and apply practical security controls.

beginner.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals (Microsoft Azure AZ-900)
beginner.outcome: Understand Azure services, cloud concepts, pricing, support and governance, and prepare for the AZ-900 examination.

intermediate.name: Data Analytics with Excel & Power BI
intermediate.outcome: Model data across related tables, write DAX measures, and build and publish interactive dashboards.

intermediate.name: Python for Data Analysis
intermediate.outcome: Manipulate and clean large datasets with pandas, produce statistical summaries and visualisations, and automate repetitive analysis.

intermediate.name: Frontend Development with React
intermediate.outcome: Build React applications, manage application state, consume live APIs, and deploy production applications.

intermediate.name: Backend Development with C# and .NET
intermediate.outcome: Build and secure REST APIs, design and query relational databases, and deploy backend services.

intermediate.name: Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps & Power Automate)
intermediate.outcome: Build business applications, automate workflows, and securely connect applications to organisational data.

intermediate.name: Network & Systems Administration
intermediate.outcome: Configure and troubleshoot networks, administer users and servers, and support organisational infrastructure.

intermediate.name: Cybersecurity Operations
intermediate.outcome: Monitor systems, interpret security alerts, investigate incidents, and work according to security operations procedures.

intermediate.name: Product Management
intermediate.outcome: Turn business problems into product requirements, prioritise roadmaps, manage delivery cycles, and work with engineering and design teams.

advanced.name: Advanced Excel & Financial Modelling
advanced.outcome: Build structured financial models, perform scenario and sensitivity analysis, and automate recurring reporting.

advanced.name: Advanced Power BI (DAX, Data Modelling & Deployment)
advanced.outcome: Write complex DAX, design performant data models, and deploy and secure reports across an organisation.

advanced.name: Azure Administrator & Solutions Architect (AZ-104, AZ-305)
advanced.outcome: Administer production Azure environments, design solutions against business and compliance requirements, and prepare for both certification examinations.

advanced.name: Full-Stack Development with C# and Blazor
advanced.outcome: Build complete applications across frontend and backend, implement authentication and data access, and deploy production applications.

advanced.name: Advanced Cybersecurity & Network Security
advanced.outcome: Design and harden network architectures, conduct vulnerability assessments, and lead structured incident response.

advanced.name: Data Engineering (SQL, Pipelines & Warehousing)
advanced.outcome: Write and optimise advanced SQL, build reliable data pipelines, and model data warehouses for analytics.

advanced.name: Data Centre Analysis & Infrastructure Management
advanced.outcome: Analyse infrastructure capacity, availability and performance, plan capacity against demand, and report infrastructure health.

advanced.name: AI & Generative AI for Professionals
advanced.outcome: Apply generative AI to professional work, recognise its limitations, and build repeatable AI-assisted workflows.
